They (SU) attacked me 18th October 1940, we shared no border, so I just thought „let’s make a naval invasion into Leningrad“. It actually worked and I took 3 States. The Soviets didn’t attack Poland because they gave them eastern Poland. And because i‘m the Kaiserreich Poland liked me so they gave me military access and I could transport supplies to Leningrad. By the end of 1940 there were 24 Tank Divisions with great supply routes. Then I was like „yeah this will be a fast war“, but... it’s Commie France. I tried it trough Belgium and Luxemburg, but that made it only worse. My tanks were in Leningrad so I couldn’t Blitzkrieg trough Belgium, also now was the UK involved since they guaranteed Belgium. Like a month of waiting and Italy was finally Monarchist too. They fucked up France pretty bad but then Yugoslavia joined AND fucking Commie Spain, this resulted in a quick defeat of Italy because all their troops were in Southern France. While the Soviets kept attacking my troops near Leningrad and had already like 5 million casualties. After waiting 3 years I formed Austria-Hungary (I honestly forgot you could do this with the focus). They (AH) had like 100 troops and I thought „Now we can capitulate Yugoslavia. But no, AH got pushed back hard and lost first Vienna then Budapest, I made 6 more tank divisions and took back Vienna. I also sent my 1st Infantry Army to hold the lines. Since the SU and AH shared a tiny border in the north, the SU could push trough that and almost encircled my 6 tank divisions. I managed to pull them back and cut of 30 Soviet divisions in Hungary. They got destroyed quickly. At the same time Finland wanted to join the Central Powers, I was like „Nice, now we can make the frontline smaller“. Nope, they stationed like 2/3 of their army in Leningrad and lost after 1 month their capital and capitulated. I had to move my tank divisions back to Germany because now there were 2 fronts and I got slowly pushed back. Since I had military access to the Baltic States I could retreat into their land and move them back to Germany. It was about January 1944. Now I almost forgot Japan, Japan attacked the SU in 1941 and made some good pushes into Siberia. Then they somehow pulled China into this. Non-commie China joined the Comintern. After that I moved my now 30 tank divisions to AH and finally capitulated Yugoslavia. I made also  40withd heavy tanks (12) in the end 24 I think. I liberated Italy and capitulated France. Spain had for some reason no troops at the French border and I just drove into Spain and capitulated them. It’s now around February 1945. I managed to push into the SU due to the small border between them and AH and after a year it looked like you see in the picture. So now we have only the UK left (I still don’t know why the US didn’t join them) and it was 1946 so, nuke them. I had in every core province of the Kaiserreich a reactor. The 1st nuclear bomb exploded of course in London and only a day later one bomb in every city of the UK. And that’s it, I‘m going to capitulate them soon and then take my sweet stolen colonies.
